title: Beat the Bugs
shareTitle: Beat the Bugs — Bubble Up, Brush Bright!
description: Power up the soap shield, scrub for 20 active seconds, and brush every tooth surface to send Kawaii germs and cavity bugs packing.
learningGoals: Practice the hand-washing sequence and a 20-second scrub
Practice gentle tooth-brushing coverage and grown-up-assisted flossing
Recall brushing two minutes, two times a day
interactionModel: Large picture-first mission cards, tap tools, forgiving continuous coverage gestures, and floss targets.
feedbackModel: Authored raster board swaps, bubble/star progress, narrated encouragement, and two session badges.

modes.title: Suds Shield
modes.skill: wash hands: wet, soap, scrub all surfaces, rinse

modes.title: Smile Shield
modes.skill: brush every tooth surface, floss with a grown-up
